description: Get messages from a channel or DM with user names resolved

include_all_metadata.description: Pass Slack's include_all_metadata option to conversations.history

include_rich_message_fields.description: Include Slack message attachments, blocks, metadata, files, and reactions when present

latest.description: Unix timestamp - get messages before this time (boundary timestamp included)

oldest.description: Unix timestamp - get messages after this time (boundary timestamp included)

resolve_users.description: Convert user IDs to names (default true)

name: slack_conversations_history
